purpose: Teach: 東欧/山道/ナレーション/サーブ/スーツケース/露天風呂/ピント/節分

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、東欧、絶対、の音楽、絶対、好きだよね
lines.en: Riku, you're totally obsessed with Eastern European music, aren't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing curiosity. Quick attack on his name. Warm—she's noticed something about him. Slight uptick at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、山道、絶対、ハイキング、絶対、絶対、つきあえよ、桜
lines.en: You should seriously come hiking with me in the mountains, Sakura.
lines.style: Hopeful, slightly earnest underneath the cool exterior. Leans into the ask. Softer on her name at the end—it matters that it's her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、ナレーション、絶対、上手いね
lines.en: Actually, you're pretty good at that narration thing.
lines.style: Genuine acknowledgment breaking through sarcasm. Faster pace, like she's catching herself being sincere. Slight defensiveness under the praise.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテニスの、本気で、絶対、サーブ、絶対、ヤバいぜ、桜
lines.en: Your tennis serve is seriously ridiculous, Sakura.
lines.style: Admiring, a little in awe. Sits with the compliment—doesn't rush past it. Warm on her name, like he's letting himself say it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、スーツケース、絶対、デカいな
lines.en: That's a huge suitcase you've got there.
lines.style: Dry observation with a hint of amusement. Steady pace. The tone of someone noticing something practical and slightly amused by it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、温泉の、絶対、露天風呂、絶対、行きたいぜ、桜
lines.en: I really want to check out an outdoor hot spring bath with you, Sakura.
lines.style: Eager but trying not to show how much he wants this. Quick breath before her name. Hopeful underneath—vulnerable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のカメラの、本気で、絶対、ピント、絶対、合ってるぜ
lines.en: Your camera's actually in focus for once.
lines.style: Playful jab wrapped in genuine recognition. Quick, light rhythm. Testing—like she's being affectionate through teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、節分、絶対、家で、絶対、お祝いした?桜
lines.en: Did you actually celebrate Setsubun at home?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, close and personal. Softer attack. He's asking because he actually wants to know about her—not making conversation.
